title: Filter events by source or provider
description: Find every event raised by a given source (ProviderName).

windowsCommandTemplate.name: Get-WinEvent
windowsCommandTemplate.commandPattern: Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName='{logName}'; ProviderName='{providerName}'; StartTime=(Get-Date).AddDays(-{days})} | Select-Object TimeCreated,Id,LevelDisplayName,Message | Format-Table -AutoSize

parameters.name: logName
parameters.label: Log name
parameters.description: Name of the log to search

parameters.name: providerName
parameters.label: Provider name
parameters.description: Exact name of the provider or source

examples.description: Fast way to filter the errors (Level=2) of the last 24 hours. Much faster than Get-EventLog on large logs.

Show the last 100 events of the System log. Get-WinEvent is the modern cmdlet (it replaces Get-EventLog). -MaxEvents limits the results. It reads the classic logs AND the newer Applications and Services logs. Faster and more flexible than Get-EventLog.

List ALL the event logs available on the system. Returns the name, maximum size, record count and status (enabled or disabled). There can be hundreds of logs (System, Application, Security + all the Applications and Services logs). Use this command to discover the available logs.

Show the events of the PowerShell log. Applications and Services logs have path-like names (slashes). This log records all PowerShell activity: commands run, errors, scripts. Essential for security audits and PowerShell troubleshooting.

notes: To list every available provider: (Get-WinEvent -ListLog *).ProviderNames | Sort-Object -Unique

fr.title: Filtrer les événements par source/fournisseur
fr.description: Recherche tous les événements provenant d'une source spécifique (ProviderName)
fr.notes: Pour lister tous les fournisseurs disponibles: (Get-WinEvent -ListLog *).ProviderNames | Sort-Object -Unique

Ce journal enregistre toutes les activités PowerShell : commandes exécutées, erreurs, scripts. Essentiel pour l'audit de sécurité et le troubleshooting PowerShell.
